item.question: How does transforming measurements into the dq coordinate frame aid in impedance estimation?
item.answer: Transforming measurements into the dq coordinate frame aids in simplifying calculations and improving accuracy by isolating variation-sensitive components. The q-axis, being sensitive to variations, is minimized while relying on the less sensitive d-axis, thus reducing errors caused by grid voltage fluctuations.
